Never use it to recreate text, buttons, images, forms, video, accordions, carousels, timers, sticky bars or popups.","documentationLinks":[{"uri":"https://help.instapage.com/hc/en-us/articles/205221768-Embedding-custom-HTML-or-widgets-into-an-Instapage-landing-page"}]}],"texts":[{"id":"11:3","text":"PAGE & REUSE"},{"id":"11:4","text":"Page-level features, reuse and exceptions"},{"id":"11:6","text":"Reuse classes"},{"id":"11:7","text":"Page-local: built for this page. My Block: a saved copy; each instance can diverge; safe to edit per page. Global Block: one synchronized block; editing it changes every page that uses it, live pages included, and needs a Manager when any of them is live. Default to page-local or My Block. A Global Block needs a written reason, an owner and an approver: legal or footer content, a compliance module, truly global navigation, a centrally maintained section. Never make a block global just because it is reusable."},{"id":"11:33","text":"IP / Tag"},{"id":"11:34","text":"Spec annotations for the margin, outside the design frames: reuse class, device visibility, sticky blocks, exceptions.
